recipes.title: Brewed Lemon Balm, Blueberry & Honey Rolled Oats
recipes.summary: Soothing stovetop rolled oats simmered directly in freshly brewed lemon balm herbal tea and milk, topped with blueberries and honey.

ingredient_details.note: steeped covered 5 minutes from 1 tbsp dried or 2 tbsp fresh leaves

steps: Steep lemon balm leaves in 3/4 cup hot water covered for 5 minutes, then strain.
Simmer rolled oats in the brewed lemon balm tea and milk for 6 to 7 minutes until velvety soft.
Spoon into a warm bowl and top with blueberries, honey, and fresh lemon zest.
tips: Always cover lemon balm while steeping so its gentle citrus aromatic oils stay inside the brew instead of escaping in steam.
Naturally caffeine-free and calming for easy mornings.

recipes.title: Chilled Brewed Lemon Balm, Peach & Chia Overnight Oats
recipes.summary: Make-ahead silky oats soaked overnight in cooled brewed lemon balm tea, almond milk, chia seeds, vanilla, and diced sweet peaches.

ingredient_details.item: finely diced ripe or thawed peaches

steps: Brew 2 lemon balm tea bags (or 2 tbsp dried herb) in 3/4 cup hot water covered 5 minutes, strain, and cool.
Stir cooled lemon balm tea, almond milk, rolled oats, chia seeds, and vanilla in two jars and chill overnight.
Top with juicy diced peaches right before serving.
tips: Lemon balm's gentle citrus fragrance makes chilled overnight oats taste bright like sunshine.
Zero cooking needed in the morning.

recipes.title: Lemon Balm Tea-Poached Pears over Greek Yogurt
recipes.summary: Soft, fragrant pears gently simmered in freshly brewed lemon balm tea, honey, and ginger, served warm over cool plain Greek yogurt.
steps: Steep lemon balm in 1 1/2 cups boiling water covered 5 minutes and strain into a small saucepan.
Simmer pear halves gently in the brewed lemon balm tea with honey and ginger slices covered 10 to 12 minutes until fork-tender.
Spoon warm fragrant pears and a splash of syrup over cool plain Greek yogurt.
tips: Poached pears cut effortlessly with a spoon and are soothing to swallow.
Keep leftover pears in their tea syrup in the fridge for 3 days.

recipes.title: Lemon Balm-Infused Honey, Ricotta & Berry Toast
recipes.summary: Whole-grain toast spread with cool creamy ricotta and sweet berries, drizzled with a quick warm brewed lemon balm-honey glaze.

ingredient_details.item: strong freshly brewed lemon balm tea

steps: Simmer strong brewed lemon balm tea and honey in a small saucepan 3 minutes until lightly syrupy.
Spread warm whole-grain toast generously with creamy ricotta and top with fresh berries.
Drizzle the warm aromatic lemon balm honey syrup right across both slices.
tips: That fragrant lemon balm syrup also tastes wonderful over pancakes or plain yogurt.
Naturally sweet and gently uplifting.

recipes.title: Brewed Lemon Balm, Vanilla & Orange Chia Pudding
recipes.summary: Calm, silky no-cook chia pudding made with cooled brewed lemon balm tea, oat milk, vanilla, maple syrup, and sweet orange segments.
steps: Whisk cooled brewed lemon balm tea, oat milk, chia seeds, maple syrup, and vanilla thoroughly.
Rest 5 minutes, whisk once more to eliminate clumps, divide into two bowls, and chill at least 3 hours.
Serve chilled topped with juicy diced sweet orange.
tips: Delicate, spoon-soft, and rich in gentle soluble fiber.
Brew extra lemon balm tea at night to sip warm before bed and chill the rest for breakfast.

recipes.title: Lemon Balm Tea-Simmered Quinoa, Cucumber & Chickpea Bowl
recipes.summary: Fluffy quinoa simmered gently in freshly brewed lemon balm infusion, tossed with tender chickpeas, crisp cucumber, olive oil, and feta.
steps: Simmer rinsed quinoa in brewed lemon balm tea with a pinch of salt, covered, for 14 to 15 minutes until tender and fluffy.
Fluff quinoa into a bowl and cool 3 minutes.
Toss with chickpeas, diced cucumber, extra-virgin olive oil, fresh lemon juice, and crumbled feta.
tips: Cooking grains in brewed lemon balm tea subtly perfumes every spoonful with bright lemony calm.
Omit feta for a fully plant-based midday bowl.

recipes.title: Golden Carrot, Ginger & Lemon Balm Infusion Soup
recipes.summary: Silky, restorative pureed carrot and sweet potato soup enriched with freshly brewed lemon balm tea and gentle ginger.
steps: Simmer sliced carrots, diced sweet potato, grated ginger, and vegetable broth 16 minutes until completely soft.
Remove from heat, pour in freshly brewed lemon balm tea and extra-virgin olive oil, and blend completely smooth.
Ladle warm into cozy bowls.
tips: Adding freshly brewed lemon balm tea off the burner keeps its soft citrus notes lively without boiling them away.
Velvety, naturally dairy-free, and gentle on digestion.

recipes.title: Baby Spinach, Strawberry & Lemon Balm Tea Vinaigrette Salad
recipes.summary: Tender spinach, sliced strawberries, toasted walnuts, and goat cheese tossed in a light fragrant brewed lemon balm, honey, and olive oil vinaigrette.

ingredient_details.item: strong cooled brewed lemon balm tea

steps: Shake strong cooled lemon balm tea, apple cider vinegar, extra-virgin olive oil, and a pinch of salt in a jar until emulsified.
Arrange baby spinach and sliced strawberries in a wide salad bowl.
Drizzle with the fragrant herbal vinaigrette and finish with walnuts and goat cheese.
tips: Using brewed herbal tea in vinaigrette lightens the oil while adding a bright garden-lemon lift.
Add shredded poached chicken to make it a higher-protein plate.

recipes.title: Lemon Balm-Infused Chicken, Barley & Zucchini Broth Bowl
recipes.summary: Light comforting soup-bowl warming tender poached chicken, cooked barley, and soft zucchini in savory chicken broth brightened with brewed lemon balm.
steps: Simmer chicken broth and diced zucchini 6 minutes until soft.
Stir in cooked barley and shredded poached chicken and warm through 2 minutes.
Remove from heat, stir in freshly brewed lemon balm tea and olive oil, and ladle into warm bowls.
tips: Gentle lemon balm adds bright freshness to brothy grain bowls without harsh vinegar acidity.
Hydrating, soft, and filling.

recipes.title: Creamy White Bean, Pear & Lemon Balm Dressing Salad
recipes.summary: No-cook Mediterranean plate tossing tender cannellini beans, ripe diced pear, baby greens, and parsley in brewed lemon balm-Dijon dressing.

ingredient_details.item: strong cooled brewed lemon balm tea

steps: Whisk cooled strong lemon balm tea, olive oil, Dijon mustard, and a pinch of salt until silky.
Toss cannellini beans, diced pear, baby spinach, and parsley gently with the dressing.
Serve cool right away.
tips: Dijon mustard binds herbal tea and olive oil smoothly into a creamy dressing.
Mild, plant-based, and high in soluble fiber.

recipes.title: Aromatic Brewed Lemon Balm Poached Salmon & Asparagus
recipes.summary: Delicate, buttery-soft salmon fillets and tender asparagus tips gently poached in freshly brewed lemon balm tea with garlic and olive oil.
steps: Pour freshly brewed lemon balm tea and sliced garlic into a wide skillet and bring to a very gentle shimmer.
Nestle salmon fillets and asparagus pieces into the aromatic tea, cover, and poach 8 to 9 minutes until salmon flakes effortlessly.
Plate warm and finish with extra-virgin olive oil and a tiny squeeze of lemon.
tips: Herbal tea poaching keeps salmon extraordinarily moist and fills the kitchen with a peaceful lemon scent.
Serve over warm jasmine rice or quinoa.

recipes.title: Gentle Brewed Lemon Balm Poached Chicken & Couscous
recipes.summary: Moist chicken breasts poached in savory broth blended with freshly brewed lemon balm tea, served over fluffy tea-broth couscous and peas.
steps: Warm chicken broth and brewed lemon balm tea in a wide skillet to a bare simmer; add chicken, cover, and gently poach 13 to 14 minutes until 165 F.
Ladle 1 1/4 cups of the hot poaching liquid over couscous and frozen peas in a bowl, cover 5 minutes, and fluff with olive oil.
Slice the juicy poached chicken and serve atop the fragrant lemony couscous.
tips: The herbal poaching liquid does double duty by steaming fluffy couscous in 5 minutes flat.
Soft, mild, and effortless to chew.

recipes.title: Lemon Balm Tea-Infused Rice Bowl with Flaky Cod & Spinach
recipes.summary: Delicate Japanese-style dinner cooking jasmine rice in brewed lemon balm tea and topping it with tender poached cod, ginger, and wilted spinach.
steps: Simmer jasmine rice in 1 1/4 cups freshly brewed lemon balm tea covered for 14 minutes until tender and fragrant.
Meanwhile gently poach cod fillets with ginger in the remaining 3/4 cup brewed lemon balm tea covered 8 minutes, tucking spinach in for the last minute.
Serve flaky cod and tender spinach over the lemony rice with a drizzle of olive oil.
tips: Calm, clean flavors that feel soothing for evening digestion.
Naturally gluten-free and dairy-free.

recipes.title: Soothing Lemon Balm & White Miso Silken Tofu Noodle Bowl
recipes.summary: Warm plant-based supper uniting freshly brewed lemon balm tea, mild white miso, tender rice noodles, bok choy, and pillowy silken tofu.
steps: Simmer 1 1/2 cups water with rice noodles and chopped bok choy 4 minutes until tender, then turn off heat.
Stir in freshly brewed lemon balm tea and slip in soft tofu cubes.
Dissolve white miso in a ladleful of warm broth, stir gently into the pot off-heat, and finish with toasted sesame oil.
tips: Brewed lemon balm adds citrus brightness to gentle miso soup without curdling or sharp acidity.
Warm, hydrating, and calming before bedtime.

recipes.title: Creamy Lemon Balm Tea, Sweet Pea & Parmesan Orzo
recipes.summary: One-pan risotto-style orzo simmered in vegetable broth and freshly brewed lemon balm tea with sweet green peas, olive oil, and Parmesan.
steps: Simmer orzo in vegetable broth and half the brewed lemon balm tea for 8 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Pour in remaining lemon balm tea and frozen green peas and simmer 3 minutes until creamy and tender.
Remove from heat, fold in olive oil and Parmesan cheese, and serve warm.
tips: One-pan orzo releases natural starch for risotto creaminess with almost zero effort.
Top with flaky poached salmon or chickpeas if desired.

recipes.title: Chilled Brewed Lemon Balm, Blueberry & Yogurt Smoothie
recipes.summary: Calming berry smoothie using chilled brewed lemon balm tea as the fragrant base with frozen blueberries, Greek yogurt, banana, and honey.
steps: Pour chilled brewed lemon balm tea and plain Greek yogurt into a blender.
Add frozen blueberries, banana, and honey.
Blend 45 seconds until deep violet, frothy, and silky smooth.
tips: Brew a small pitcher of lemon balm tea and chill it in the fridge so smoothies take just 2 minutes all week.
Naturally caffeine-free and soothing any time of day.

recipes.title: Sunlit Peach, Ginger & Brewed Lemon Balm Smoothie
recipes.summary: Sunny dairy-free smoothie combining chilled brewed lemon balm tea, frozen peaches, oat milk, fresh ginger, and sweet vanilla.
steps: Combine chilled brewed lemon balm tea, oat milk, frozen peach slices, grated ginger, and vanilla in a blender.
Blend 45 seconds until smooth and creamy golden.
Pour into a chilled glass and enjoy immediately.
tips: Peach and lemon balm taste like a calm summer garden.
Great afternoon sipper with zero caffeine.

recipes.title: Strawberry, Rolled Oat & Brewed Lemon Balm Smoothie
recipes.summary: Wholesome pink smoothie blending chilled brewed lemon balm tea, almond milk, frozen strawberries, rolled oats, and ripe banana.
steps: Add chilled brewed lemon balm tea, almond milk, rolled oats, frozen strawberries, and banana to a blender.
Blend on high 55 seconds until lush rosy pink and completely smooth.
Pour into a glass and enjoy chilled.
tips: Lemon balm gives a delicate pink-lemonade aroma without sharp citrus acid.
Sustaining whole-grain fiber with gentle fruit sweetness.

recipes.title: Calm Mango, Spinach & Brewed Lemon Balm Green Smoothie
recipes.summary: Hydrating green smoothie blending chilled brewed lemon balm tea, baby spinach, sweet frozen mango, ripe banana, and chia seeds.
steps: Blend chilled brewed lemon balm tea and baby spinach 20 seconds until completely smooth.
Add frozen mango, banana, and chia seeds.
Blend another 35 seconds until silky bright green.
tips: Using chilled herbal tea instead of plain water turns a basic green smoothie fragrant and comforting.
Naturally dairy-free and nut-free.

recipes.title: Evening Tart Cherry, Kefir & Lemon Balm Smoothie
recipes.summary: Peaceful evening wind-down smoothie combining chilled brewed lemon balm tea, plain kefir, frozen tart cherries, and banana.
steps: Combine chilled brewed lemon balm tea, plain kefir, frozen cherries, banana, and honey in a blender.
Blend 45 seconds until creamy magenta and frothy.
Sip slowly and chilled.
tips: Combines two gentle evening favorites—cherries and caffeine-free lemon balm—in a gut-friendly kefir base.
Swap kefir for almond milk if you want a dairy-free glass.

recipes.title: Iced Brewed Lemon Balm, Fresh Lemon & Honey Press
recipes.summary: Classic herbal garden cooler pouring strong freshly brewed lemon balm tea over ice with freshly squeezed lemon juice and a touch of honey.
steps: Steep lemon balm in 1 cup hot water covered 5 minutes, strain, and stir in honey while warm.
Chill or cool slightly, then stir in freshly squeezed lemon juice.
Pour over a tall glass of ice cubes and enjoy refreshing and crisp.
tips: Double or triple the batch to keep a hydrating pitcher ready in the refrigerator all afternoon.
Zero caffeine and gentle on sensitive stomachs.

recipes.title: Chilled Brewed Lemon Balm, Cucumber & Apple Spa Cooler
recipes.summary: Ultra-refreshing botanical tonic mixing chilled brewed lemon balm tea, fresh cucumber juice, crisp apple juice, and spearmint.
steps: Fill a tall glass with ice cubes and lightly bruised fresh spearmint leaves.
Pour in chilled brewed lemon balm tea, cucumber juice, and crisp apple juice.
Stir gently and serve cold.
tips: Crisp apple juice provides just enough orchard sweetness without needing syrup.
Wonderful hydration on warm days.

recipes.title: Sparkling Brewed Lemon Balm, Orange & Ginger Tonic
recipes.summary: Bubbly botanical citrus press combining chilled brewed lemon balm tea, freshly squeezed orange juice, ginger juice, and sparkling water.

ingredient_details.item: chilled strong brewed lemon balm tea

steps: Pour chilled brewed lemon balm tea, freshly squeezed orange juice, and ginger juice over ice cubes.
Top with plain sparkling water.
Give one light stir and serve immediately.
tips: Feels like a festive cafe spritzer with calm, caffeine-free herbal notes.
Still cold water substitutes smoothly for sparkling water.

recipes.title: Ruby Blueberry, Lime & Brewed Lemon Balm Cooler
recipes.summary: Jewel-toned berry-herbal cooler pressing fresh blueberries straight into chilled brewed lemon balm tea with a squeeze of bright lime.
steps: Pulse blueberries with chilled brewed lemon balm tea, lime juice, and honey for 15 seconds.
Pour through a fine-mesh strainer over ice cubes for a vivid, smooth ruby-violet cooler.
Sip cold right away.
tips: Thawed frozen blueberries release even deeper purple color and rich berry juice when pulsed.
Naturally antioxidant-rich and caffeine-free.

recipes.title: Golden Pear, Pineapple & Brewed Lemon Balm Press
recipes.summary: Mellow orchard-tropical iced press layering chilled brewed lemon balm tea with pure pear juice, pineapple juice, and a drop of lemon.
steps: Fill a glass with ice cubes.
Pour in chilled brewed lemon balm tea, pure pear juice, pineapple juice, and fresh lemon juice.
Stir gently and enjoy cold.
tips: Gentle, softly sweet, and soothing with zero added sugar.
Can also be gently warmed as a cozy afternoon herbal punch.

recipes.title: Lemon Balm Tea, Mashed Banana, Cinnamon & Walnut-Oil Oats
recipes.summary: Calm morning rolled oats simmered in covered brewed lemon balm tea with mashed banana and ground cinnamon, crowned with sweet blueberries and cold-pressed walnut oil.
steps: Steep 1 tbsp dried or 2 tbsp fresh lemon balm leaves in 3/4 cup hot water covered 5 minutes, then strain.
Simmer rolled oats in the brewed lemon balm tea and milk with mashed banana and ground cinnamon for 6 to 7 minutes until silky.
Spoon into a warm bowl, top with sweet blueberries, and drizzle with cold-pressed walnut oil.
tips: Covering lemon balm while steeping traps its delicate lemony aromatics right inside the brew.
Mashed banana provides natural creaminess and sweetness with zero refined sugar.

recipes.title: Fresh Lemon Balm, Cantaloupe, Spearmint & Flaxseed-Oil Yogurt Bowl
recipes.summary: Cool morning bowl pairing plain Greek yogurt and cold-pressed flaxseed oil with ripe cantaloupe, juicy navel orange, snipped fresh lemon balm, and cool spearmint leaves.
steps: Swirl cold-pressed flaxseed oil into plain Greek yogurt inside a chilled bowl.
Arrange diced ripe cantaloupe and juicy navel orange segments on top.
Snip fresh lemon balm and fresh spearmint leaves over the fruit and sprinkle with orange zest.
tips: Lemon balm and spearmint are gentle garden cousins that lift sweet melon effortlessly.
No cooking required and rich in cool morning hydration.

recipes.title: Savory Lemon Balm, Pearl Barley, Celery & Golden Turmeric Porridge
recipes.summary: Warm whole-grain pearl barley simmered with finely diced celery stalk, golden turmeric, cracked black pepper, and olive oil, finished with fragrant snipped fresh lemon balm.
steps: Warm half the olive oil in a saucepan and soften finely diced celery stalk with ground turmeric and cracked black pepper for 3 minutes.
Add cooked pearl barley and vegetable broth; simmer gently for 8 minutes until thick and creamy.
Remove from heat, fold in snipped fresh lemon balm leaves and remaining olive oil, and serve warm.
tips: Fresh lemon balm gives warm savory barley a soft citrus lift without harsh vinegar or sharp lemon juice.
Top with a soft-poached egg if you like extra breakfast protein.

recipes.title: Fresh Lemon Balm, Tarragon, Black Pepper & Poached Salmon Soft Scramble
recipes.summary: Silky low-heat olive-oil scrambled eggs folded gently with flaky poached salmon, finely snipped fresh lemon balm, fragrant tarragon, and cracked black pepper.
steps: Whisk eggs with 1 tbsp water and freshly cracked black pepper in a small bowl.
Warm extra-virgin olive oil over low heat and slowly fold the eggs 2 to 3 minutes until moist soft curds form.
Turn off heat, fold in flaked poached salmon, snipped fresh lemon balm, and chopped fresh tarragon, and plate immediately.
tips: Lemon balm supplies a natural lemony perfume that flatters delicate poached salmon and eggs.
Gentle low heat guarantees a velvety easy-to-swallow morning meal.

recipes.title: Lemon Balm Tea-Steeped Sweet Barley with Dark Chocolate, Cherry & Clove
recipes.summary: Cozy sweet morning pearl barley warmed in freshly brewed lemon balm tea with ground cinnamon, a pinch of clove, juicy dark cherries, and melting shaved dark chocolate.
steps: Steep 1.5 tbsp dried or 3 tbsp fresh lemon balm leaves in 1 cup boiling water covered 5 minutes, then strain.
Simmer cooked pearl barley, brewed lemon balm tea, oat milk, halved cherries, ground cinnamon, and a pinch of ground cloves for 8 to 10 minutes until soft and creamy.
Spoon into warm bowls and scatter finely shaved dark chocolate over top so it melts into silky ribbons.
tips: Lemon balm's gentle citrus aroma highlights dark chocolate and sweet cherry like a warm breakfast pastry.
Naturally dairy-free and rich in soluble barley fiber.

recipes.title: Lemon Balm, Poached Chicken, Red Grape & Celery Walnut-Oil Bowl
recipes.summary: Cool garden chicken salad pairing shredded poached chicken, halved red grapes, and finely diced celery stalk with fresh lemon balm, chopped tarragon, Greek yogurt, and walnut oil.
steps: Stir plain Greek yogurt, cold-pressed walnut oil, snipped fresh lemon balm, and chopped fresh tarragon until creamy and aromatic.
Fold in finely shredded poached chicken, finely diced celery stalk, and quartered sweet red grapes until coated smoothly.
Serve immediately over soft lettuce leaves or tucked into warm whole-grain bread.
tips: Lemon balm perfumes creamy chicken salad naturally so you don't even need heavy lemon juice.
Quartered grapes and shredded chicken keep every bite tender and effortless to eat.

recipes.title: Lemon Balm, Fresh Basil, Spearmint & Olive-Oil Mashed White Bean Toast
recipes.summary: Creamy mashed cannellini beans folded with finely minced celery stalk, extra-virgin olive oil, black pepper, fresh lemon balm, sweet basil, and spearmint over toasted bread.
steps: Mash rinsed cannellini beans with extra-virgin olive oil, 1 tbsp water, and cracked black pepper until silky and spreadable.
Fold in finely minced celery stalk along with snipped fresh lemon balm, fresh sweet basil, and spearmint.
Spread thickly onto warm lightly toasted whole-grain bread and enjoy immediately.
tips: Three cooling mint-family herbs turn humble white beans into a fragrant spring tartine.
Plush texture holds together neatly on toast with high plant fiber.

recipes.title: Lemon Balm, Saffron, Fennel Seed & Celery Pearl Barley Broth Soup
recipes.summary: Golden garden soup simmering pearl barley and sliced celery stalks in vegetable broth infused with saffron, crushed fennel seed, olive oil, and freshly brewed lemon balm.

ingredient_details.note: plus 2 tbsp snipped fresh leaves for garnish

steps: Warm olive oil in a pot over medium-low heat and soften sliced celery stalks with lightly crushed fennel seeds for 4 minutes.
Pour in vegetable broth, crumbled saffron threads, and cooked pearl barley; simmer gently 10 minutes until golden and tender.
Turn off heat, stir in warm brewed lemon balm tea, ladle into bowls, and scatter snipped fresh lemon balm leaves over top.
tips: Adding brewed lemon balm tea off the boil keeps its floral citrus oils vibrant and soothing.
Hydrating, soft, and gentle on digestion.

recipes.title: Lemon Balm, Fresh Shiso, Ginger & Poached Salmon Sesame Rice Noodles
recipes.summary: Chilled silky rice vermicelli and moist flaked poached salmon tossed with grated fresh ginger, toasted sesame oil, fragrant fresh lemon balm, crisp shiso, and cilantro.
steps: Cook rice vermicelli noodles 4 minutes until soft, drain, rinse in cool water, and snip once with kitchen shears.
Whisk toasted sesame oil, finely grated ginger, and 2 tbsp warm water in a mixing bowl.
Toss cooled noodles gently with ginger-sesame dressing, snipped fresh lemon balm, shiso, and cilantro, then top with flaked poached salmon.
tips: Lemon balm brings soft citrus perfume to chilled sesame noodles with zero harsh acid.
Snipping rice noodles keeps bites neat and easy to handle.

recipes.title: Lemon Balm, Sweet Orange, Sumac & Pumpkin-Seed-Oil Warm Lentil Bowl
recipes.summary: Tender warm lentils tossed with finely diced celery stalk, sweet navel orange segments, warm ground cumin, ruby sumac, snipped fresh lemon balm, and roasted pumpkin seed oil.

ingredient_details.item: cooked tender brown or green lentils

steps: Warm cooked lentils, finely diced celery stalk, ground cumin, and 3 tbsp water in a saucepan for 5 minutes until celery softens gently.
Transfer to a bowl and toss with fresh orange juice, ruby ground sumac, and roasted pumpkin seed oil.
Fold in sweet orange segments and snipped fresh lemon balm leaves right before serving warm.
tips: Warming lentils briefly lets them drink up the orange-sumac-lemon balm fragrance.
Pre-cooked steamed lentils make this a 10-minute high-fiber lunch.

recipes.title: Lemon Balm, Thyme, Sage & Olive-Oil Poached Chicken over Barley
recipes.summary: Moist chicken strips gently poached in covered brewed lemon balm tea and chicken broth scented with fresh thyme, sage, and olive oil, spooned over tender pearl barley.
steps: Warm olive oil over low heat with fresh thyme and finely chopped sage for 45 seconds until aromatic.
Pour in brewed lemon balm tea and chicken broth, bring to a bare simmer, lay chicken strips in the pan, cover, and poach gently 10 to 12 minutes until tender (165 F).
Spoon poached chicken and fragrant herb broth over warm pearl barley and garnish with snipped fresh lemon balm.
tips: Poaching chicken in half brewed lemon balm tea and half broth produces a remarkably fragrant, silky pan jus.
Gentle evening protein with whole-grain comfort.

recipes.title: Lemon Balm Tea, Saffron, Sweet Orange & Fennel Seed Poached Salmon
recipes.summary: Buttery salmon fillets gently poached in fragrant brewed lemon balm tea, sweet orange juice, saffron threads, crushed fennel seed, and extra-virgin olive oil.

ingredient_details.item: strong freshly brewed lemon balm tea
ingredient_details.note: steeped covered 5 minutes, plus 1 tbsp fresh leaves

steps: Steep crumbled saffron threads directly inside the hot brewed lemon balm tea for 4 minutes.
Warm olive oil in a skillet with crushed fennel seeds for 30 seconds, then pour in the golden saffron-lemon balm tea, fresh orange juice, and orange zest.
Nestle salmon fillets in the fragrant liquid, cover, and poach over low heat 9 to 10 minutes until flaky; plate with warm pan juices and fresh lemon balm leaves.
tips: Steeping saffron right in hot lemon balm tea doubles the golden perfume with zero extra dishes.
Serve alongside soft jasmine rice or mashed Yukon potatoes.

recipes.title: Lemon Balm, Turmeric, Ginger, Cumin & Cilantro Creamy Red Lentil Dal
recipes.summary: Soothing split red lentil dal bloomed in rice bran oil with fresh ginger, golden turmeric, cumin, and black pepper, finished off-heat with bright fresh lemon balm and cilantro.
steps: Warm rice bran oil in a saucepan over medium-low heat and bloom grated ginger, ground turmeric, ground cumin, and cracked black pepper for 45 seconds.
Add rinsed split red lentils and vegetable broth; simmer gently covered 15 minutes until creamy and velvet-smooth.
Take off the heat, fold in snipped fresh lemon balm leaves and chopped cilantro, and ladle warm into bowls.
tips: Lemon balm provides delicate lemon-herb brightness at the end of dal cooking without sourness.
Split red lentils cook naturally silky with zero blender needed.

recipes.title: Lemon Balm, Rosemary, Summer Savory & Celery Braised White Bean Stew
recipes.summary: Comforting Tuscan-style soup stewing creamy cannellini beans, diced Yukon potatoes, and tender celery stalks with olive oil, rosemary, summer savory, black pepper, and fresh lemon balm.

ingredient_details.note: peeled of strings and thinly sliced

steps: Soften thinly sliced celery stalks in olive oil with finely minced rosemary, summer savory, and cracked black pepper for 4 minutes.
Add diced Yukon potatoes, rinsed cannellini beans, and vegetable broth; cover and simmer gently 13 to 14 minutes until potatoes turn mashably soft.
Press a few beans and potatoes against the pot edge to thicken naturally, turn off heat, and stir in snipped fresh lemon balm leaves.
tips: Fresh lemon balm brightens hearty rosemary and summer savory bean stew beautifully.
Peeling celery strings guarantees a completely smooth spoonable dinner.

recipes.title: Lemon Balm, Fresh Shiso, Anise Seed & Ginger Steamed Tofu Rice Bowl
recipes.summary: Serene evening bowl warming custard-soft silken tofu in brewed lemon balm and vegetable broth steeped with anise seed, grated ginger, rice bran oil, sesame oil, and fresh shiso.

ingredient_details.note: steeped in tea infuser and removed

steps: Simmer vegetable broth, brewed lemon balm tea, sliced ginger, rice bran oil, and anise seeds (in a tea infuser) gently for 6 minutes, then remove the infuser.
Lower heat to a bare simmer and warm soft silken tofu cubes gently in the aromatic broth for 4 minutes.
Spoon warm jasmine rice into bowls, ladle tofu and fragrant broth on top, and finish with snipped fresh shiso, fresh lemon balm, and toasted sesame oil.
tips: A light infusion of anise seed and lemon balm produces a tranquil, spa-like evening broth.
Soft tofu and warm broth make this effortlessly gentle to swallow.

recipes.title: Lemon Balm, Wild Blueberry, Banana, Ginger & Flaxseed-Oil Silk Smoothie
recipes.summary: Calm violet smoothie blending cooled brewed lemon balm tea and fresh leaves with wild blueberries, creamy banana, zesty fresh ginger, oat milk, and cold-pressed flaxseed oil.
steps: Pour chilled brewed lemon balm tea and oat milk into a blender.
Add frozen wild blueberries, ripe banana, grated fresh ginger, and cold-pressed flaxseed oil.
Blend on high speed for 45 seconds until satin-smooth and pour into a chilled glass.
tips: Keep a small pitcher of covered-steeped lemon balm tea chilled in the fridge for 2-minute smoothies all week.
Naturally caffeine-free and soothing any time of day.

recipes.title: Lemon Balm, Chilled Cantaloupe, Sweet Orange & Spearmint Calm Smoothie
recipes.summary: Sunny peach-hued smoothie blending fresh lemon balm and cool spearmint leaves with chilled sweet cantaloupe, juicy navel orange, plain yogurt, and flaxseed oil.
steps: Add chilled cantaloupe cubes, peeled sweet orange, Greek yogurt, fresh lemon balm, spearmint leaves, and flaxseed oil to a blender.
Blend on high for 40 seconds until airy, frosty, and completely smooth.
Pour into a glass and enjoy chilled right away.
tips: Fresh lemon balm and spearmint make ripe cantaloupe taste refreshing like chilled orchard sorbet.
Use chilled brewed lemon balm tea instead of fresh leaves when out of garden season.

recipes.title: Lemon Balm, Tart Raspberry, Purple Grape & Fresh Basil Kefir Smoothie
recipes.summary: Vibrant probiotic kefir smoothie pairing fresh lemon balm and sweet basil with frozen raspberries, juicy purple grapes, and a velvety teaspoon of walnut oil.

ingredient_details.item: chilled seedless purple or red grapes

steps: Combine plain kefir, chilled purple grapes, frozen raspberries, fresh lemon balm, fresh sweet basil, and cold-pressed walnut oil in a blender.
Blend on high speed for 45 seconds until smooth and rosy purple.
Strain briefly if you prefer zero raspberry seeds, then pour into a chilled glass.
tips: Sweet grapes balance raspberry brightness while letting lemon balm and basil shine.
Plain kefir gives gentle live probiotic cultures in a light sip.

recipes.title: Evening Lemon Balm Tea, Dark Chocolate, Cherry & Cinnamon Banana Smoothie
recipes.summary: Unwinding evening smoothie blending chilled brewed lemon balm tea and oat milk with dark sweet cherries, banana, rich dark chocolate, and warming ground cinnamon.

ingredient_details.item: chilled freshly brewed lemon balm tea
unsweetened dark cocoa powder or shaved 70% dark chocolate

steps: Pour chilled brewed lemon balm tea and oat milk into a blender.
Add frozen dark cherries, ripe banana, dark chocolate, and ground cinnamon.
Blend on high for 45 seconds until thick, velvety, and frosty, then pour into a glass.
tips: Lemon balm tea adds a gentle botanical whisper beneath rich cherry and dark chocolate.
A comforting, naturally sweet evening treat.

recipes.title: Lemon Balm, Sweet Orange, Golden Turmeric, Shiso & Banana Oat Smoothie
recipes.summary: Luminous botanical smoothie blending fresh lemon balm and green shiso with peeled sweet orange, creamy banana, golden turmeric, fresh ginger, and chilled oat milk.
steps: Add chilled oat milk, peeled sweet orange, frozen banana slices, fresh lemon balm, fresh shiso leaves, ground turmeric, and grated ginger to a blender.
Blend on high speed for 45 seconds until creamy and sunlit gold-green.
Pour into a tall glass and enjoy right away.
tips: Sweet orange and banana mellow earthy turmeric while lemon balm and shiso keep the finish crisp.
Naturally dairy-free and caffeine-free.

recipes.title: Lemon Balm, Celery Stalk, Sweet Orange, Ginger & Turmeric Botanical Press
recipes.summary: Bright pressed juice blending fresh lemon balm leaves and hydrating celery stalks with sweet navel orange, zesty fresh ginger, and golden ground turmeric.
steps: Process fresh lemon balm leaves, chopped celery stalks, peeled sweet orange, and ginger through a juicer (or blend with 1/3 cup cold water for 30 seconds and strain cleanly through a fine sieve).
Whisk ground turmeric smoothly into the pressed golden-green juice.
Pour over two ice cubes and sip immediately.
tips: Lemon balm rounds out fresh celery juice with delicate citrus sweetness.
Press pulp firmly through the sieve if using a blender to capture every drop of herb oil.

recipes.title: Lemon Balm, Chilled Cantaloupe, Green Grape & Spearmint Garden Cooler
recipes.summary: Serene chilled garden cooler blending fresh lemon balm, spearmint, and sweet basil leaves with ripe cantaloupe and seedless green grapes, strained silky smooth.
steps: Blend chilled cantaloupe, seedless green grapes, fresh lemon balm, spearmint, sweet basil, and 1/4 cup cold water for 25 seconds.
Strain smoothly through a fine-mesh sieve into a chilled glass over ice.
Enjoy immediately while crisp and fragrant.
tips: Naturally sweet melon and grape juice needs zero added honey or sugar.
A cool, calming botanical refresher for warm days.

recipes.title: Lemon Balm Tea, Dark Cherry, Raspberry & Ruby Sumac Evening Press
recipes.summary: Ruby herbal cooler uniting chilled brewed lemon balm tea with 100% dark cherry juice, crushed ripe raspberries, zesty fresh ginger, and citrusy ground sumac.

ingredient_details.item: chilled freshly brewed lemon balm tea

steps: Pulse chilled brewed lemon balm tea, pure dark cherry juice, raspberries, ground sumac, and grated fresh ginger for 15 seconds.
Strain cleanly through a fine sieve into an ice-filled tall glass to remove raspberry seeds.
Stir gently and sip chilled.
tips: Tart cherry and lemon balm make a famously soothing caffeine-free evening drink.
Ruby sumac lends bright berry tang without extra acid.

recipes.title: Lemon Balm, Brewed Black Tea, Blueberry, Orange & Clove Iced Tonic
recipes.summary: Aromatic iced tea press steeping lemon balm leaves with smooth black tea and a single whole clove, shaken chilled with crushed blueberries and sweet squeezed orange juice.

ingredient_details.item: dried lemon balm leaves (or 2 tbsp fresh)

ingredient_details.note: steeped 2 minutes with lemon balm and clove

steps: Steep 1 black tea bag, lemon balm leaves, and 1 whole clove together in 3/4 cup hot water covered for 3 minutes, then strain and chill.
Pulse chilled spiced lemon balm black tea with blueberries and freshly squeezed orange juice for 15 seconds.
Strain through a fine sieve over ice and sip refreshing and cool.
tips: One single whole clove infuses subtle orchard warmth without overpowering sweet blueberries and lemon balm.
Swap decaf black tea if enjoying late in the afternoon.

recipes.title: Lemon Balm, Crisp Celery Stalk, Cilantro, Fennel Seed & Ginger Green Press
recipes.summary: Crisp green digestive press uniting chilled fennel-seed lemon balm infusion with freshly blended celery stalk, sweet apple, bright cilantro, and grated ginger, strained silky clear.

ingredient_details.note: steeped with fennel seed and strained
steeped in tea and strained out

steps: Steep lemon balm leaves and crushed fennel seeds in 1/2 cup hot water covered for 4 minutes, strain cleanly, and chill.
Blend the chilled fennel-lemon balm infusion with chopped celery stalks, chopped apple, fresh cilantro, and grated ginger for 30 seconds.
Press through a fine-mesh strainer into an ice-filled glass and enjoy crisp and fresh.
tips: Lemon balm, fennel seed, and fresh ginger form a classic soothing botanical trio.
Straining yields a spotless emerald pour with zero fibrous bits.
